# ColorHandle { #anylumino.ColorHandle }

```python
ColorHandle(value='#1473e6', *, disabled=False, **kwargs)
```

Display a draggable-looking color handle.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type     | Description                            | Default     |
|----------|----------|----------------------------------------|-------------|
| value    | optional | Initial value and synced Python value. | `'#1473e6'` |
| disabled | optional | Whether user interaction is disabled.  | `False`     |
